title: Weather Watchers — Weather & Climate
description: Observe and record daily weather, count weather data, compare sunlight and shade, explore temperature, and identify safe choices for stormy or icy conditions.
learningFocus: Collect and describe observations of local weather over time.
Use simple evidence to compare weather conditions and how sunlight can affect objects.
adultGuidance: Observe real weather together for several days and let your child record what they actually see rather than aiming for a predetermined result. For the sunlight investigation, keep the ice cubes and trays alike, change only sun versus shade, and discuss the evidence after observing safely.

seo.title: Weather Watchers Worksheets | Learning Made Simple
seo.description: Five free Kindergarten science activities for observing weather, comparing weather data, investigating sunlight and shade, and discussing weather safety.
